title: Thunder Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the LS2 Thunder Matte Black is tailored for spirited twisties and aggressive canyon carving. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1287g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Entry-level full face with good ventilation and removable liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; may feel tight on very round heads.

technical_analysis: Features Kinetic Polymer Alloy (KPA) / HPFC High Performance Fiberglass Composite shell construction paired with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield. The interior utilizes Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the LS2 Thunder Matte Black: combining Spain / China 🇪🇸🇨🇳 craftsmanship with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield and Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: LS2 Thunder Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the LS2 Thunder Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in LS2's Full Face lineup, the Thunder Matte Black brings Spanish engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The LS2 Thunder Matte Black represents LS2's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the LS2 Thunder Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
